title: Haye Abbas Mera Haye Alamdar Mera
body:
Haye Abbas mera haye alamdar mera
Haye Abbas mera haye alamdar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Thamkar tooti kamar dhast me kehtey teh Hussain
Baad Abbas key ab jeena hai dushwaar mera
Hogaya mujhse juda haye madadgaar mera
<<MINI>>
Haye Abbas mera haye alamdaar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Masq par teer laga sar pe laga gurze sitam - haye Abbas mera....
Tashna lab rehgaya darya paa wafaadaar mera
<<MINI>>
Haye Abbas mera haye alamdar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Khoon ek aankh mein ek aankh me jab teer laga - haye Abbas mera....
Bas tadapta hi raha talibe deedaar mera
<<MINI>>
Haye Abbas mera haye alamdar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Gham yeh kis tarha sahoo kaise mein Zainab se kahoo - haye Abbas mera
Kargaya tanha mujhe fouj ka salaar mera
<<MINI>>
Haye Abbas mera haye alamdar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Khoo'n roolati rahi aye bhai musibat teri - haye Abbas mera
Hoke be-dhasht gira jaffer e tayyar mera
<<MINI>>
Haye Abbas mera haye alamdar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Laash qaimay me na lejaye wasiyat hai yahi - haye Abbas mera
Pyaase bachoun se hai sharminda yeh ghamqaar mera
<<MINI>>
Haye Abbas mera haye alamdar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hai yeh saaqi ki dua aisi azadaari karoo - haye Abbas mera
Khud shah e wala kahein hai yeh azadaar mera
<<MINI>>
Haye Abbas mera haye alamdar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Azz....kousar saaqi
